blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) signers cannot converse in real time across different sign languages today: existing sign-to-sign translation systems run offline, requiring the full source clip before any target sign is emitted.
Live use cases — e.g. broadcast interpretation and two-way video calls — instead demand simultaneous output, while the source signer is still signing.
We present, to our knowledge, the first simultaneous sign → sign \text{sign}\!\to\!\text{sign} ( S2S ) translation system, with two wait- k k regimes: test-time wait- k k inference applied directly to a full-sentence model, and a trained wait- k k model via stochastic multi-path supervision.
We further introduce ca-Stream-AL , a computation-aware latency metric for streaming output.
Averaged across six S2S directions on both a smaller human-verified test set and a larger synthetic S2S corpus, our streaming system achieves a 38 % 38\% ca-Stream-AL reduction while staying within a 9 % 9\% DTW-PA-MPJPE increase and a 2.1 2.1 BLEU-4 drop compared to the full-sentence baseline.
A word-order case study probes how the streaming model handles word order mismatch between different sign languages — a consequence of simultaneous translation.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Sign language is the primary, most natural communication medium for many Deaf and hard-of-hearing ( DHH ) users — which is why major broadcasts such as White House press briefings provide live ASL interpretations alongside written captions, recognizing that the visual-spatial grammar of sign carries information that written text alone cannot.
Yet DHH signers across different sign-language communities cannot converse in real time today. The cascade approach, which chains a single sign-to-text ( S2T ) model with a spoken-language MT system and a text-to-sign ( T2S ) generator, incurs substantial latency; meanwhile, both the recent direct S2S model of Wu et al. (2026) and the earlier approach of Inan et al. (2025) remain offline , requiring the entire source clip before any target sign can be generated.
This rules out the live deployments — e.g. broadcast interpretation and two-way video calls — where simultaneous S2S would matter most.

手语是许多聋哑人和听力困难(DHH)使用者的主要、最自然的交流媒介,这就是为什么白宫新闻简报等主要广播除了书面字幕之外,还提供现场的ASL解释,同时认识到可视空间的标志语法载有仅书面文本无法掌握的信息。
然而,今天不同手语社区的DHH签名人无法实时交谈。 级联方法将单一的标注对文本(S2T)模型与口语MT系统和文本对签名(T2S)生成器连在一起,产生相当的耐久性;同时,吴等人(2026年)和伊南等人(2025年)最近的直接S2S模型仍然离线,要求在生成任何目标标志之前需要整个源剪辑.
这排除了现场部署——如广播口译和双向视频通话——同步S2S最要紧的地方.

blocks.en: Simultaneous machine translation between spoken languages faces an analogous problem and commonly adopts wait- k k policies ( Ma et al., 2019 ) , which delay generation until k k source units have been observed and then proceed incrementally. We extend this principle to direct S2S translation as an end-to-end streaming pipeline, with the wait- k k schedule governing the entire path from source-sign encoding and LM inference to target-sign decoding and rendering. This setting also introduces a distinct latency challenge: unlike text tokens, generated sign chunks have non-negligible playback duration, during which new source input can arrive and subsequent chunks can be computed. Existing latency metrics therefore do not fully capture the timing experienced in streaming sign output.
blocks.zh: 口语之间的同步机器翻译面临类似的问题,通常采用wait-k k 政策(Ma et al., 2019),延迟生成直到观测到k源单位,然后逐步进行. 我们将此原理扩展为直接S2S翻译作为端到端的流线管道,其中等待-k时刻表规范从源码编码和LM推论到目标标识解码和渲染的整个路径. 这种设置还带来了一个明显的耐久性挑战:与文本符号不同的是,生成的符号块有不可忽略的回放时间,在回放期间可以到达新的源输入,并可以计算后续的块. 因此,现有的延迟度衡量标准不能充分掌握流转信号输出的时间安排。

blocks.en: We present, to our knowledge, the first simultaneous S2S translation system, adapting wait- k k under both test-time and trained regimes. We further introduce ca-Stream-AL , a source-centric, computation-aware latency metric designed for streaming sign generation, accounting jointly for source arrival, model computation, and target playback where AL ( Ma et al., 2019 ) and CA-AL ( Ma et al., 2020 ) can underestimate latency.

blocks.en: 2 Direct Sign-to-Sign Translation
blocks.zh: 2 直接签名对签名翻译

blocks.en:
The direct S2S task takes a signed utterance in one sign language and produces a sign sequence in another within a single model, rather than cascading through sign-to-text recognition, spoken-language machine translation, and text-to-sign generation. Inan et al. (2025) present the first attempt in this setting and contribute methods for aligning multiple signed-language corpora to enable cross-lingual training; however, their generated signs achieve a back-translation BLEU-4 of 0 in two of the six translation directions, with the best direction reaching only 6.81, indicating the limited translation quality of this early system. Wu et al. (2026) extend the line with two ingredients: (i) a back-translation -synthesized sign ↔ sign \text{sign}\!\leftrightarrow\!\text{sign} parallel corpus across ASL / CSL / DGS , and (ii) a single encoder–decoder architecture trained jointly on T2S and S2S , sharing a frozen VQ-VAE sign tokenizer with SOKE ( Zuo et al., 2024 ) .
Both prior systems are offline : the encoder consumes the entire source clip before any target sign is emitted, which precludes live use.

blocks.en:
We follow the pipeline of Wu et al. (2026) without architectural modification.
A frozen decoupled VQ-VAE ( Zuo et al., 2024 ) tokenizes 25 Hz SMPL-X poses into three streams of sign tokens (body, left hand, right hand), with temporal downsampling factor 4 → \to effective 6.25 Hz token rate.
A single transformer, initialized from mBART -large-cc25 ( Liu et al., 2020 ) , processes both T2S and S2S samples; sign-side input uses the SOKE ( Zuo et al., 2024 ) embedding fusion (one fused embedding per frame), text-side input uses standard subword embeddings.
Source / target sign language is signaled via special-token prefixes ( ASL , CSL , DGS ); the same module serves both T2S and S2S tasks.
At test time the decoder emits target sign tokens autoregressively; the VQ-VAE decoder reconstructs SMPL-X poses, which are rendered to an avatar in parallel with generation.

blocks.en: mBART ’s encoder is bidirectional: for any observed source prefix, the hidden state 𝐡 i \mathbf{h}_{i} at position i i attends to all tokens in that prefix, including those after i i . Consequently, when a new source token becomes available, the hidden states of earlier positions may also change and must be recomputed. A causal-mask approximation would discard the bidirectional inductive bias of the pre-trained backbone. We therefore interleave reading and writing: at each decoder step t t we reveal one more source token, re-run the encoder over the current prefix 𝐱 ≤ g k ​ ( t ) \mathbf{x}_{\leq g_{k}(t)} , and decode y t y_{t} against the updated hidden states (Algorithm 1 ); T max T_{\text{max}} caps the number of decoder steps. blocks.en: We introduce computational-aware stream average lagging ( ca-Stream-AL ), a source-centric computation-aware latency metric for streaming sign output, reported in seconds along the 25 fps source timeline (each emitted chunk spans w chunk = 4 / 25 w_{\text{chunk}}=4/25 s = 160 =160 ms of wall-clock time). We begin by discussing the limitations of classical average lagging (AL), and develop ca-Stream-AL in two stages: a non-computation-aware formulation ( Stream-AL ) that establishes the source-centric view, followed by a computation-aware extension that incorporates per-step computation lag ( ca-Stream-AL ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Classical Average Lagging
blocks.zh: 4.1 古典平均拉线

blocks.en: Classical average lagging, introduced by Ma et al. (2019) , measures latency only over target steps up to the point at which the full source has been consumed. It is defined as AL = 1 τ ​ ∑ t = 1 τ [ g ⁡ ( t ) − ( t − 1 ) / r ] \mathrm{AL}=\frac{1}{\tau}\sum_{t=1}^{\tau}\big[g(t)-(t-1)/r\big] (5) where r = | 𝐲 | | 𝐱 | r=\frac{|\mathbf{y}|}{|\mathbf{x}|} is the target-to-source length ratio and τ = min ⁡ { t : g ⁡ ( t ) = | 𝐱 | } \tau=\min\{t:g(t)=|\mathbf{x}|\} is the first target step at which the full source has been consumed.

This formulation has two limitations that motivate our extensions: 1. Target-tail truncation. By definition, AL stops at τ \tau and excludes all subsequent target steps from the latency computation (Fig. 2(a) ). These steps can still carry nonzero lag relative to the proportional ideal and should therefore contribute to the metric. When r ≈ 1 r\approx 1 , the omitted tail is typically short and the resulting error is small; as r r increases, however, the tail can account for a substantial fraction of the target sequence, making the underestimation increasingly severe. 2. No duration for streamed target tails. The second issue arises for temporally realized outputs such as speech or sign video (i.e., in text-to-speech, speech-to-speech, or sign language translation scenarios). Unlike text, where the tail can be presented as a complete sequence once generated, a streamed output must unfold over time (at a reasonable rate) for the perceiver to consume it; its remaining tail therefore cannot be treated as if it were emitted instantaneously at the source end, nor can it be presented too fast which interferes with understanding. For example, in speech-to-speech translation, substantially increasing the playback rate degrades naturalness and can disrupt comprehension ( Zheng et al., 2020 ) .

blocks.en: To account for the streaming duration of the target tail, we reformulate lag on a shared source-centric timeline (Fig. 2(c) ). Rather than indexing latency by target emissions and asking how much source has been consumed, we index it by the fixed-rate source clock and ask how much target progress should have been completed at each source step. Since source chunks arrive every w chunk w_{\text{chunk}} seconds, each source index i i corresponds to a fixed wall-clock interval.

The full pipeline is:

blocks.en: The upstream regression from raw video to SMPL-X , however, is treated as an external preprocessing stage. We assume that it operates at or above the 25 fps source rate, so that it does not accumulate a growing backlog relative to the incoming stream. This assumption is practical with modern pose regressors, several of which approach or exceed real-time throughput on contemporary GPUs. For example, OSX ( Lin et al., 2023 ) reports 12.2 fps on V100, which scales to approximately 56 fps on H100 under the reported ∼ \sim 4.6 × \times transformer-inference speedup, while faster alternatives such as SMPLer-X ( Cai et al., 2023 ) already exceed 25 fps on V100. Under this assumption, upstream regression contributes only a bounded processing offset rather than an accumulating delay, and is therefore excluded from ca-Stream-AL . If the regressor runs below the source frame rate, its backlog instead grows over time, in which case the reported ca-Stream-AL should be interpreted as a lower bound on the true end-to-end latency.
blocks.zh: 然而,从原始视频到SMPL-X的上游回归被视作一个外部预处理阶段。 我们假设它运行在25 fps源速率或以上,这样它不会相对于来流累积越来越多的积压. 这种假设对现代的姿势递减器来说是实用的,其中几种在当代GPU上接近或超过实时吞吐量. 例如,OSX(Lin等人,2023年)在V100上报告了12.2 fps,在报告的\sim 4.6 ×\times变压器-推导速度下,H100上比例为约56 fps,而SMPLer-X(Cai等人,2023年)等更快的替代品在V100上已经超过了25 fps. 根据这一假设,上游回归只能造成有限度的处理抵消,而不是累积的拖延,因此被排除在 " 结构-AL " 之外。 如果递减器运行在源帧率以下,则其积压会随着时间而增加,在这种情况下,所报告的a-Stream-AL应被解释为对真正端到端的延迟的较低约束。

blocks.en: We retain the standard bidirectional encoder of Wu et al. (2026) ; under streaming inference, the available source prefix is re-encoded at each step, and this computation is included in c i c_{i} .
blocks.zh: 我们保留了Wu等人的标准双向编码器(2026年);在流派推论中,可用源前缀在每个步骤上重新编码,这个计算包含在c i c_{i}.

blocks.en: Stream-AL is related to duration-aware latency metrics such as ATD ( Kano et al., 2023 ) , but differs in its reference frame. ATD remains target-centric and measures delay with respect to corresponding input positions, whereas Stream-AL measures target progress on a shared source-time axis against the proportional ideal i ​ r ir . This source-centric formulation accounts explicitly for the physical duration of the output stream and permits signed lag, including negative values when target progress is ahead of the proportional ideal.
blocks.zh: Stream-AL与诸如ATD(Kano等人,2023年)等具有持续时间认识的延迟度测量标准有关,但参考框架不同。 ATD仍然以目标为中心,在相应的输入位置方面措施拖延,而Stream-AL措施的目标是在共享源-时间轴上对照比例理想i r ir取得进展。 这种以源为中心的配方明确反映了输出流的实际持续时间,并允许签名的滞后,包括目标进度高于比例理想时的负值.

blocks.en: The computation-aware extension is complementary to prior computation-aware AL formulations ( Ma et al., 2020 ) . Rather than attaching computation cost only to output emission, ca-Stream-AL models the wall-clock completion time of every streaming step. The per-step cost c i c_{i} therefore includes computation incurred even when no target token is emitted, such as repeated source-prefix encoding during the initial wait phase, together with decoding and rendering when output is produced. Through the recurrence in Eq. 8 , any computation that exceeds the available wall-clock budget is carried forward as backlog, allowing ca-Stream-AL to capture both per-step processing latency and its accumulation over the stream.
blocks.zh: 计算意识延长是对先前计算意识AL配体的补充(Ma等人,2020年)。 Ca-Stream-AL不只将计算成本附加在输出排放上,而是模拟每个流动步骤的墙时完成时间。 因此,每步成本c i c_{i}包括即使没有发射目标符号也发生的计算,如初始等待阶段重复的源前缀编码,以及输出时的解码和渲染. 通过Eq.8的重现,任何超过可用时钟预算的计算都会作为积压结转,使ca-Stream-AL能够捕捉每步处理延迟及其在溪流上的积累.

blocks.en: 6 Analysis: Word Order and Streaming Anticipation
blocks.zh: 6 分析:词序和流序预测

blocks.en:
Simultaneous translation surfaces a problem that the offline setting can ignore: the decoder cannot reorder content it has not yet observed.
At low k k , the wait- k k policy can only wait (paying latency) or anticipate (risking error).
This tension is as sharp for sign-to-sign as for text-to-text simultaneous MT because the canonical word orders of ASL , CSL , and DGS also differ substantially: ASL is broadly SVO with frequent topic-fronting; DGS is largely SOV, placing the verb at the clause end; CSL admits both SVO and SOV constructions and is topic-prominent, and — unlike DGS — places sentential negation before the predicate it scopes over.
A streaming CSL → \to DGS system must therefore delay clause-final material across earlier source tokens and, in the negative case, promote the adjective ahead of the negator.
blocks.zh:
同时翻译会显现出一个离线设置可以忽略的问题:解码器无法重新排序它尚未观察到的内容.
在低k k 时, wait - k k 策略只能等待( 付费延迟) 或预测( 冒险错误) 。
由于ASL,CSL,和DGS的单词顺序也有很大差异,因此这种张力对于签名到签名来说和文本到文本同时MT一样尖锐: ASL广义上是SVO,经常进行主题前置;DGS主要是SOV,将动词放在条款的结尾;CSL同时承认SVO和SOV的构造,并且是主题突出的,并且——与DGS不同——在它的上游范围被覆盖之前,放置了注意的否定.
因此,流到DGS系统的CSL →\\必须把条款-最终材料延后到较早的源令牌上,在负面情况下,则在否定者之前推广形容词.

blocks.en:
The CSL source glosses to “mountain / color / snow-white” ( shānshàng / yánsè / xuebai ), a topic-comment construction in which “color” is a discourse marker introducing the descriptor.
The reference DGS gloss is berg ix schnee (mountain ix snow); the indexical ix has no lexical correspondent in the source.
The model emits berg schnee : it preserves the canonical mountain-then-snow order shared by both languages, decomposes the CSL compound “snow-white” into the DGS root schnee , and correctly drops the source-side “color” that does not surface in DGS .
This is the regime where streaming costs little: anticipation is not required because the two canonical orders agree on the content sequence.
blocks.zh:
CSL来源将“山/色/雪-白”(shānshàng / yánsè / xuebai)这一专题评论构造,其中“颜色”是介绍描述词的语句标记。
参考文献DGS gloss为berg ix schnee(山地ix雪);索引ix在来源中没有词典通讯员.
模型释放了berg schnee : 它保留了两种语言共同使用的舟山-当时的雪花顺序,将 CSL 复合体“snow-white”分解为 DGS root schnee ,并正确放下了源边的“颜色”而不在 DGS 中浮出水面 。
这就是流水成本很低的制度:不需要预测,因为两条条条令商定内容序列。

blocks.en:
The CSL source glosses to “not cold” ( bu leng ), with the negator first.
The reference DGS gloss is kalt neg-nichts (cold not): DGS places sentential negation after the predicate it scopes over.
A faithful streaming policy at k = 3 k{=}3 would have to either wait for the adjective (“cold”) to arrive before committing to anything — foregoing the latency advantage of streaming — or anticipate the adjective from a single negation sign, which is under-determined. (Noted: To avoid confusion, k k in this paper always refers to sign tokens rather than the gloss unit. So wait- 3 3 means waiting for three sign tokens when we can not even get the meaning of "cold" at the beginning.)
The model takes neither path: it emits neg-nichts kalt the moment the negator is observed, copying source order and violating the DGS canonical order on a two-token utterance.
The miss is exactly the failure mode Ma et al. (2019) predict for short clauses whose reordering window exceeds k k .
blocks.zh:
CSL的源头是“不冷”(bu leng),首先是“不冷”。
参考文献DGS Gloss为 kalt neg-nichts (cold not): DGS在它超越前缀后 放置了提醒性否定
K=3 k{=}3的忠实流派政策必须等到形容词(“冷”)到达之后,才能做出任何承诺——超越流派的暂时优势——或者从单一否定符号中预言形容词,该形容词的确定性不足。 (注意:为避免混淆,本文k k 总是指符号符号而不是光泽单位. 3 3 表示等待三个符号 当我们甚至不能得到"冷"的意思 在开头。 )
该模型既不走路径,也不走路径:在观测到neg-nichts kalt时,它就会发出negator,复制源指令,并违反DGS双键语音上的Canonical指令.
错失恰恰是故障模式Ma et al. (2019)预测的重排窗口超过kk的短条款.

blocks.en:
The two picks bracket the regime: when source and target canonical orders agree over content (Fig. 5(a) ), small- k k streaming reproduces the target sequence and even resolves source-only function words; when they disagree on a short, clause-internal swap (Fig. 5(b) ), the wait/anticipate tradeoff is unfavorable at k = 3 k{=}3 and the model defaults to source order.
A quantitative version of this analysis — per-direction anticipation lead time on a gloss-tagged subset — is left to future work and noted in Limitations.

blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en:
We adopt the prefix-to-prefix framework of Ma et al. (2019) , which factorizes streaming generation as p ⁡ ( y t ∣ x ≤ g ⁡ ( t ) , y < t ) p(y_{t}\mid x_{\leq g(t)},\,y_{<t}) for a monotonic schedule g g .
The wait- k k policy is the special case g ⁡ ( t ) = k + t − 1 g(t)=k+t-1 .
AL ( Ma et al., 2019 ) , AP ( Cho and Esipova, 2016 ) , and DAL ( Cherry and Foster, 2019 ) provide the classical text-MT latency framework; we follow Ma et al. (2019) in using greedy decoding (beam search is ill-defined under partial-source observation). Ma et al. Elbayad et al. (2020) train a single model that serves multiple k k at inference, sidestepping the per- k k retraining cost discussed in our Limitations.

Kano et al. (2023) introduces ATD, which considers target-token duration in delay accounting and is the closest prior metric in spirit to ca-Stream-AL .
ATD is target-centric (per-target-token delay against the corresponding clipped input index) and conventionally non-negative; ca-Stream-AL is source-centric, uses the proportional diagonal i × r i\times r ( r = | 𝐲 | | 𝐱 | r=\frac{|\mathbf{y}|}{|\mathbf{x}|} ) as reference, admits a closed form for wait- k k , and permits negative values when r < 1 r<1 . Ma et al. (2020) extends wait- k k from text-to-text to streaming speech-to-text translation and introduces computation-aware AL (CA-AL); ca-Stream-AL applies the same computation-aware idea to our source-centric formulation.

Kano等人(2023年)介绍了 " ATD " ,认为目标计算持续时间是延迟核算的,是Ca-Stream-AL精神上最接近的先前衡量标准。
ATD以目标为中心(每个目标键相对于相应的剪切输入指数的延迟),常规为非阴性;ca-Stream-AL以源为中心,使用比例对角的i × ri\times r(r = | y | | | | r=\frac{|\mathb{y}|}{|\mathb{x}|} }|})作为参考,承认等待-k的封闭形式,并在r < 1 r < 1时允许负值. Ma等人(2020年)将wait-kk从文本对文本延伸至流式语音对文本翻译,并引入了计算意识AL(CA-AL);ca-Stream-AL将相同的计算意识思想应用于我们以源为中心的配方.

blocks.en:
Yin et al. (2021) introduce SimulSLT, which applies wait- k k to full-sentence sign-to-text translation ( Camgöz et al., 2018 ; Camgöz et al., 2020 ) with a learned gloss-boundary predictor that decides when to read versus emit; their target is spoken-language text, and latency is measured by classical (target-centric) AL on text tokens.
Our setting differs along two axes: the target is rendered sign output emitted in fixed wall-clock chunks rather than text tokens at an instant — which is what motivates the source-centric, computation-aware ca-Stream-AL (§ 4 ) — and the source itself is a sign stream, making the present work, to our knowledge, the first streaming sign → sign \text{sign}\!\to\!\text{sign} system in the literature.

我们的设置在两个轴上有所不同:目标被制成以固定的墙钟块发射的标志性输出,而不是一瞬间发出的文本符号——这是激励以源为中心,具有计算意识的ca-Stream-AL(§ 4)——的来源本身是一个标志性流,使得目前的工作,据我们所知,是文献中的第一个流线性标志 \ text{sign{{!\!\!\ text{sign}系统。

blocks.en: T2S translation (or in some literature called sign language production) generates sign output from spoken-language text, either as continuous pose sequences with progressive Transformers ( Saunders et al., 2020 ) or via motion-graph and GAN-based pipelines ( Stoll et al., 2020 ) . T2S translation is offline and consumes text; we generate sign tokens conditioned on a sign-language source under a streaming policy, inheriting the prefix-to-prefix latency budget rather than full-source access.
blocks.zh: T2S翻译(或在某些被称为手语制作的文献中)从口语文本中生成符号输出,或者作为带有进步变形器的连续姿势序列(Saunders等人,2020年),或者通过运动图和GAN的管道(Stol等人,2020年). T2S翻译离线并消耗文本;我们根据流线政策生成以手语源为条件的标志符号,继承前缀到前缀的休闲预算而不是全源访问.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We presented, to our knowledge, the first simultaneous S2S translation system, closing the gap between offline S2S models and the live deployments — broadcast interpretation, two-way video calls — that require target signing to begin while the source signer is still signing.
We adapted the wait- k k policy to sign-token streams in two regimes — test-time inference on a full-sentence backbone and a trained wait- k k model via stochastic multi-path supervision — and introduced ca-Stream-AL , a source-centric computation-aware latency metric that accounts for the fixed wall-clock duration of each emitted sign chunk, which target-centric AL and CA-AL under-report.
Averaged across the six S2S directions, our streaming system cuts ca-Stream-AL by 38 % 38\% while staying within a 9 % 9\% DTW-PA-MPJPE increase and a 2.1 2.1 BLEU-4 drop relative to the full-sentence baseline.
A word-order case study surfaced the central new challenge of going simultaneous: the decoder cannot reorder content it has not yet observed, so at low k k it must trade latency for anticipation on directions whose canonical orders disagree.
We hope ca-Stream-AL and the streaming- S2S task spur further work toward real-time cross-lingual sign communication.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,我们提出了第一个同步的S2S翻译系统,缩小了离线的S2S模型与现场部署——广播口译,双向视频通话——之间的差距,这需要目标签名开始,同时源签名者仍在签名.
我们调整了“等待-k”政策,以便在两个制度下签署“等待-k”政策,即测试-时间推论全判决主干线和经过培训的“等待-k”模式,并采用了Ca-Stream-AL(以源为中心计算-意识到延迟度的衡量标准),用于计算每个发射的标志块的固定时钟持续时间,这是以AL和CA-AL为对象的低报。
平均跨越六个S2S方向,我们的流线系统将Ca-Stream-AL减少38%,同时保持在9%的DTW-PA-MPJPE增长范围内,比全判决基线减少2.1 2.1 BLEU-4。
一项文字顺序案例研究揭示了同时进行的核心新挑战:解码器不能重新排列它尚未观察到的内容,因此在低kk时,它必须用延迟来换取预期的方向,而这些方向的犬顿命令是不一致的。
我们希望Ca-Stream-AL和流传-S2S任务能进一步推动实时跨语言标志通信。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Both wait- k k regimes (§ 3 ) use the fixed unit-slope schedule g ⁡ ( t ) = k + t − 1 g(t){=}k{+}t{-}1 : after the initial k k -token wait, exactly one source token is revealed per emitted target.
The six directions, however, have source/target length ratios far from 1 1 ( r = | 𝐲 | | 𝐱 | r=\frac{|\mathbf{y}|}{|\mathbf{x}|} from ≈ 0.52 \approx 0.52 to ≈ 2.44 \approx 2.44 ; § 3.1 ), so a unit-slope read/write schedule drifts linearly from the proportional ideal i × r i\times r — the ( | 𝐱 | + 1 ) ​ ( r − 1 ) 2 \frac{(|\mathbf{x}|+1)(r-1)}{2} term that dominates Stream-AL (Eq. 7 ) when r r is far from 1 1 .
A length-ratio-aware catch-up policy ( Ma et al., 2019 ) would instead match the read:write rate to the empirical ratio: for a direction whose source runs ≈ 1.2 × \approx 1.2\times the target ( ≈ 5 \approx 5 target tokens per 6 6 source tokens), it reveals two source tokens before one of every six writes — e.g. the fifth and sixth source tokens are read together — keeping the schedule parallel to the slope- r r ideal rather than slope 1 1 , and symmetrically writes two targets per read when the target is the longer side.
We use the ratio-agnostic schedule for simplicity and direct comparability with text-MT wait- k k ; biasing the schedule by the measured per-direction ratio is left to future work and would tighten Stream-AL most on the highly asymmetric directions.

Each Train+TT model commits to one value of k k at training time; serving a different latency budget at inference requires retraining.
Multi- k k schemes ( Elbayad et al., 2020 ) sidestep this but at additional implementation cost — left to future work.
blocks.zh:
每列火车+ TT模式在培训时承诺一个kk值;在推论中提供不同的延迟预算需要再培训。
多K计划(Elbayad等人,2020年)回避了这一点,但又增加了执行成本——留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
We use uniform position sampling with m = 5 m{=}5 replicas for the stochastic multi-path objective (§ 3.2 ).
Neither m m nor the sampling distribution (e.g., geometric, early-position-biased, schedule-dependent) was tuned; both could shift the early-segment quality at low k k .
blocks.zh:
我们使用有 m = 5 m = 5 m = 5 复制品的统一位置采样,用于斜面多路径目标(第3.2节)。
m m和采样分布(如几何,早期位置偏差,时间表依赖性)都没有调制;两者都可以在低 k k k 时改变早期的分区质量.

blocks.en:
Train+TT is supervised on back-translation ( BT ) synthetic S2S pairs (§ 5.1 ): the source side is generated by the T2S direction of the same backbone and so inherits its biases.
Whether these biases interact with the streaming objective — e.g., by encouraging source-order anticipation when the target order would differ — has not been characterized.
blocks.zh:
Train+TT在后翻译(BT)合成S2S对上被监督(§5.1):源面由同一主干线的T2S方向产生,因此继承其偏差.
这些偏差是否与流线目标相互作用——例如,在目标顺序不同时鼓励来源顺序预测——没有特征。

blocks.en:
§ 6 inspects a small number of cases.
A quantitative anticipation metric (e.g., source-aligned verb-emission lead time on a gloss-tagged subset) is left to future work.
blocks.zh:
§6检查少数案件.
量化预测的衡量标准(例如,源与源相匹配的动词-在被遮盖子集上的释放准备时间)留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Quality is reported via DTW-PA-MPJPE and a downstream-evaluator BLEU-4 ; native-signer human evaluation of streamed output is left to future work and would be the right tool for assessing perceived choppiness or unnatural early-segment artefacts.

blocks.en:
Our SMPL-X -to-avatar rendering pipeline ( pyrender ) runs at ≈ 30 \approx 30 fps, contributing ≈ 132 \approx 132 ms per output chunk to ca-Stream-AL — by far the dominant per-output cost, against ∼ 10 \sim 10 ms for the encoder forward and LM decoder step combined.
Production-grade real-time avatar renderers (game-engine or neural-rendering systems) run substantially faster; swapping in such a renderer would tighten ca-Stream-AL numerically without changing the streaming policy.
A render-aware system design (e.g., overlapped render and decode) is outside this paper’s scope.

渲染系统设计(例如重叠渲染和解码)不在本文的范围之内。

blocks.en:
Schedule construction in § 3.1 re-runs the bidirectional encoder on each successive source prefix and so scales encoder work as 𝒪 ⁡ ( | 𝐱 | 3 ) \mathcal{O}(|\mathbf{x}|^{3}) (matching § 3.1 ).
This is tolerable today because rendering dominates the per-chunk cost, but the constraint binds once rendering speeds up; a causal-mask approximation would amortize the cost at the price of discarding the bidirectional prior of the pre-trained backbone.
blocks.zh:
§ 3.1中的时间表构建重运行了每个相继源前缀上的双向编码器,因此缩放编码器的工作是 O QQ (X X 3 )\ mathcal{O}(XMathbf{x}|^{3})(匹配§ 3.1 ).
这在今天是可容忍的,因为渲染在每吨成本中占主导地位,但一旦渲染速度加快,约束就会约束;一个因果-面具近似会以在预训骨干之前丢弃双向成本的价格摊还成本.

blocks.en:
We assume the upstream raw-video → \to SMPL-X pose-estimation front-end runs at ≥ 25 \geq 25 fps (matching the source frame rate); under this assumption extraction is a sub-chunk additive offset (§ 4 ), but below 25 fps a backlog accumulates linearly with | 𝐱 | |\mathbf{x}| and our ca-Stream-AL becomes a lower bound on real user-perceived latency.
The OSX regressor ( Lin et al., 2023 ) we adopt and faster alternatives such as the SMPLer-X family ( Cai et al., 2023 ) comfortably clear 25 fps on modern GPUs (§ 4 ), but a sustained deployment over long inputs would need to verify this empirically.

Following Ma et al. (2019) , we use greedy decoding because beam search is ill-defined under partial-source observation.
This leaves quality on the table relative to the (non-streaming) beam-search regime and is a shared limitation of the simultaneous-MT literature rather than specific to our work.
blocks.zh:
追随马等人(2019年),我们使用贪婪的解码,因为光束搜索在部分来源观察下定义不清.
相对于(非流式)光束搜索制度而言,这使质量处于桌面上,是同时-MT文献的共同限制,而不是我们工作特有的限制。

blocks.en:
To our knowledge there is no published simultaneous S2S system; we therefore compare only against our own full-sentence backbone and the test-time wait- k k inference variant.
Stronger external comparison will be possible once additional simultaneous S2S systems appear.

据我们所知,没有同时发布的S2S系统;因此,我们只与我们自己的完全判决主干和测试时间等待-k k推论变量进行比较。
一旦出现额外的同步S2S系统,就有可能加强外部比较。
